description: Insufficient authorization in personal notification rules in Checkmk <2.5.0p20, <2.4.0p41 and 2.3.0 (EOL) allows authenticated users to receive notifications for hosts and services they are not a contact of by defining broad personal notification rules.

When the rsyslog's `imuxsock` is parsing the TAG field from a message with a accepted shorter timestamp, the cursor used to read the message fields and the remaining message length to be read are left in a inconsistent state in relation to the content in the raw message, leading the module to read one byte past the end of the buffer holding the message.

description: A vulnerability was detected in itsourcecode Insurance Management System 1.0. The impacted element is an unknown function of the file /insertClient.php. The manipulation of the argument client_id results in sql injection. The attack can be executed remotely. The exploit is now public and may be used.

A flaw has been found in Open Asset Import Library Assimp up to 6.0.5. This affects the function ASEImporter::InternReadFile of the file code/AssetLib/ASE/ASELoader.cpp of the component ASE File Importer. This manipulation causes out-of-bounds write. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. The exploit has been published and may be used. Upgrading to version 6.0.6 mitigates this issue. Patch name: 7ccc44a338dcdcc81023484388126ab1a8250e94. You should upgrade the affected component.

Affected is the function RazorpayController::paymentSuccess of the file packages/Webkul/Razorpay/src/Http/Controllers/RazorpayController.php of the component Payment Gateway Success/Callback Controllers. Performing a manipulation results in insufficient verification of data authenticity. It is possible to initiate the attack remotely. Upgrading to version 2.4.14 is able to address this issue. It is suggested to upgrade the affected component.
